Anna (prod-tools): quick q — I'm flipping a telemetry flag in infra-repo. config-only, no code. do we bump patch?
Mike: probably not a numeric bump. we normally reserve patch for behavior/bugfixes.
Julia: semver-wise, agree. telemetry toggle doesn't change public API. prefer not to bump. but we need a tag to track the change.
Samir: our release pipeline triggers on tags matching vX.Y.Z — if we don't tag, it won't show in the releases page. that matters for audit.
Cheng: could use build/meta tag. e.g. `v1.14.3-meta.telemetry.20260315` but GitHub & some tools treat `+` build metadata oddly; using a `-meta` pre-release is more portable.
Anna (prod-tools): the goal is internal traceability only. don't want to create noise in public changelog. pre-release suffix ok? like `v1.14.3-meta`?
Julia: pre-release (`-meta`) is better than `+` because packaging tools sometimes ignore build metadata. also it's clear it's not a prod candidate.
Mike: propose rule: code changes -> bump patch. config/infra-only -> don't bump numeric version; tag with `-meta` suffix. update deploy-bot to ignore `-meta` tags for prod rollout and still surface them in internal releases. add a line in RELEASES.md explaining `meta` semantics.
Samir: to implement deploy-bot change we'll need to tighten the release regex. current matcher: `^v(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)(?:-.*)?$` — let's explicitly exclude `-meta`. example suggestion:
```
# accept only plain semver for prod rollouts
^v(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)(?!-meta).*$
```
Cheng: and sample tag command we'll use for infra flips:
```
git tag -a v1.14.3-meta -m "meta: flip telemetry flag"
git push origin --tags
```
deploy-bot: Deployment webhook: tag v1.14.3-meta created by Anna (prod-tools) — automated: no prod rollout. To force a prod rollout, add `[force-prod]` to the PR body.
Anna (prod-tools): i'll open a small PR to adjust deploy-bot regex and add docs to `RELEASES.md` with the template: `meta: infra change — no user-facing impact`.
Julia: SGTM :thumbsup:
Mike: thanks — agree on minimal churn. let's call this settled unless someone objects within 24h.
Samir: noted — i'll add a quick e2e to ensure deploy-bot still lists internal meta tags in the internal releases dashboard.
Cheng: i'll review the PR today.
Anna (prod-tools): thanks all — closing thread once PR merges :white_check_mark:
